info.name: Provides an easy way for double opt-in to their traditional channel applications like USSD.

items.docs: Confirms next action based on subscriber consent mostly for traditional channels.

info.name: Provides the ability to create a customer PreApproval Request

items.docs: Manages Customer PreApproval information by specifying the from and to 'customerIds'. For most solution the to and from customer id's will be the same. This functionality is used when the preapprovals are used to preapprove future debit transaction between different parties.

info.name: Provides the ability to cancel an existing customer PreApproval Request(s)

items.docs: Manages existing Customer PreApproval information by been able to cancel a single or multiple preapprovals (this is based on what request parameters are sent).

info.name: Generate OTP and send to the customer's registered Id

params.name: customerId
params.description: id for the Customer; if id is msisdn, format must be E.123

items.docs: Generate OTP and send it to the customer's Id

info.name: Validates the OTP sent to the subscriber from the generateotp request call

params.name: customerId
params.description: id for the Customer; if id is msisdn, format must be E.123

params.name: otpKey
params.description: Unique identifier for the OTP that was originally sent. This is the value used in the "requestOTP" method.

params.name: otp
params.description: OTP as recieved on the SMS or Email Id

items.docs: Validates the OTP sent to the subscriber. Once the otp has been verified, it will return invalid for subsequent calls.
